title: DLE webhook payload: attribution.created
description: An install was attributed to a click (FR-204). Envelope per docs/zadanie.md B.7.4.

event.description: Event type. Fixed for this schema.

id.description: Delivery identifier the receiver uses for replay protection.

occurred_at.description: When the underlying event happened, ISO 8601 with an offset.

data.description: Event payload. Every member is a string: the envelope is a flat string map on purpose, so a receiver never has to guess at a type it was not told about.

install_id.description: The SDK-generated identifier of the installation.

app_id.description: Identifier of the application the install belongs to.

confidence.description: Confidence, two decimal places. Exactly 1.00 for a deterministic strategy.

click_id.description: Identifier of the matched click; absent when nothing matched.

link_id.description: Identifier of the matched link, as a decimal string because it is a 64 bit Snowflake.
